deprecation.message: SDK 3.2 / facade 2.0 is 2 majors behind. Current is wallet-sdk@1.0.0 / facade@4.0.0 (released 2026-04-23). The WalletFacade.init({...}) constructor used in 2.0 has been removed; 4.0 reverted to `new WalletFacade(s, u, d) + .start()`. Plan a migration.
SDK 1.x is deeply outdated. No security patches expected. Migrate to current.

knownIssues.title: Invalid npm registry: npm.midnight.network does not exist
knownIssues.detail: Several community tutorials reference @midnight-ntwrk:registry=https://npm.midnight.network/. This domain has no DNS record and causes ENOTFOUND errors.
knownIssues.fix: Delete the line from .npmrc (or delete the file). All @midnight-ntwrk packages are on the standard npmjs.org registry.

knownIssues.title: Multiple versions of @midnight-ntwrk/ledger-v7 in node_modules
knownIssues.detail: When two ledger-v7 versions are loaded, transactions silently fail without errors.
knownIssues.fix: Run `npm dedupe @midnight-ntwrk/ledger-v7` (or `pnpm dedupe`). Pin one version in your root package.json.

knownIssues.title: Multiple versions of @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime in node_modules
knownIssues.detail: Mixed compact-runtime versions cause circuit serialization mismatches.
knownIssues.fix: Run `npm dedupe @midnight-ntwrk/compact-runtime`. Confirm a single version with `find node_modules -path '*/compact-runtime/package.json'`.

knownIssues.title: WalletFacade.init() in 2.x stalls on standalone dev nodes
knownIssues.detail: In SDK 2.x, WalletFacade.init() subscribes to runtime version events that the standalone node closes early. The wallet hangs in 'syncing' state forever with no error.
knownIssues.fix: Either (a) develop against preprod once past hello-world, or (b) upgrade to wallet-sdk-facade@4.0.0 which reverted to constructor + .start() pattern.

knownIssues.title: wallet-sdk subpackages span multiple major versions
knownIssues.detail: Mixing wallet-sdk-facade@4.x with wallet-sdk-shielded@2.x (etc) leads to silent type errors at runtime — facade expects state shapes the older subpackages don't produce.
knownIssues.fix: Use the @midnight-ntwrk/wallet-sdk barrel package (1.0.0) which keeps subpackages in lockstep, or pin all wallet-sdk-* packages to the same major manually.

configChecks.title: indexer-standalone 4.x requires a subscription block
configChecks.detail: Indexer 4.0.0-rc.4+ won't start without `subscription:` config; will crash-loop without a clear message.
configChecks.fix: Add a `subscription:` section to indexer.yml. Reference template in docs.midnight.network.
